user.title: Connect to Anycubic Cloud
user.description:
Sign in at https://cloud-universe.anycubic.com/file, open your browser's developer tools (F12), and run this in the Console:

```
window.localStorage["XX-Token"]
```

Paste the value below, without the surrounding quotes.

data_description.token: Around 238 characters. It is an account credential, so treat it like a password.
data_description.region: Choose China only if your Anycubic account was created in the China app.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Anycubic token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} has expired or been revoked. Fetch a new one the same way as before and paste it below.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anycubic Cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Anycubic rejected that token. Make sure you copied the whole value, with no quotes.
error.no_printers: That account has no printers. Check the printer is paired in the Anycubic app, and that you picked the right region.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: That printer is already set up.
